title: Man Between Worlds
description: A man in a long dark coat stands at the center of a large circular portal, holding a small white creature in one hand and a planet with rings in the other. A giant insect-like alien with large eyes clings to the top right of the portal while a smaller traveler with a backpack walks along a cracked path toward the scene.
